primary.figure_use: The cross-simulator learning-curve figure plots this arm only.
primary.interpretation: Both simulators receive exactly zero disturbance, isolating simulator implementation as the comparison variable with no disturbance-distribution confound.

bcod_sim_disturbed_robustness.disturbance: Existing seeded per-episode wind/current randomization from the frozen task contract.
bcod_sim_disturbed_robustness.reporting: Report separately as robustness evidence and never plot it on the same axes as the primary comparison.
bcod_sim_disturbed_robustness.interpretation: A lower result does not mean bcod-sim is worse than Gazebo; this arm solves a strictly harder task with disturbances.

decision_basis: The still-water primary comparison is selected specifically because the current Gazebo runtime cannot apply seeded wind/current at reset.

bcod_zero_disturbance_verification.result: Both vectors were exactly zero for every sampled seed; the seeded arm remains separately available and nonzero.

vrx_open_question.statement: This still-water decision does not automatically extend to VRX. Once VRX Gates A/B are known, decide separately whether its native wind, wave, and current plugins can reproduce bcod-sim's seeded per-episode ranges or are restricted to fixed values.
